ItemID: unavailable; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar-song interpretations appeal after Cheek to Cheek, but I would choose an oldies collection first today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Photographs & Memories: His Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Jim Croce's melodic storytelling fits my recent folk and singer-songwriter listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sounds of Summer: Very Best of The Beach Boys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The familiar harmonies fit my Beatles and mid-'60s listening; I would play this today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy some newer pop, but I am more interested in familiar older songs right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A country duet album is less closely connected to what I want from this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: After A Very Special Christmas, I would try another holiday album with a different vocal sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Very Best of Otis Redding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Classic soul fits the older hits I have been enjoying; I would choose this collection.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: I Will Always Love You: The Best Of Whitney Houston; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of familiar pop songs appeals, but I would prioritize the older selections this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Carole King Tapestry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The warm songwriting fits my Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Ultimate Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste.
